notes: OWNER CONSTRAINT ON ANY ANSWER, from lamontae at 2026-09-22 15:37:28Z, his words: "people need to decide themselves. and that can change. and their party doesnt solely define their decisions. ust like real life". He said this in answer to this finding. It rules out the obvious answer — that a person's position follows from their party — and it requires that a position be arrived at by the person, that it be able to change afterwards, and that party membership be one input among others rather than the determinant. Added by the research queue lane, which carried his words here verbatim and wrote nothing else into this record; the filing lane owns everything above.

SMALLEST HONEST CHANGE, corrected twice and now smaller in effort but longer in sequence. Exists: a complete exported NPC belief-formation routine (evaluatePoliticalBeliefFormation and applyNpcPoliticalBeliefFormation, re-exported from simulation/index.ts) that proposes a belief, validates it against its own decision trace and records it; a finished journal rendering beliefs, public statements and commitments; a loaded pack of 13 domains and 127 issues. Missing links, in order: (a) NOT ONE POLICY PROPOSITION IS DECLARED anywhere, and every belief writer requires one; (b) nothing schedules the formation routine — its only caller outside tests is the demo. Smallest honest change: ONE proposition row in a pack, then one call to the routine that already exists. Content first, then a scheduler. What a player would then see: people who have come to think something, and a journal with a line in it.

PLAYER-FACING INPUT: NONE, and this is the sharpest case. A player can open their journal and read what they privately think, what they said in public and what they promised — the surface is finished. Nothing they can press anywhere records any of it, and no proposition exists to hold one. The control that would create the number does not exist; only the one that displays it.

QUESTION 1 IS A REAL FORK, not a formality. The loader already distinguishes sourced from authored-fiction packs, and the sourced pack's provenance carries named sources, so a proposition added to it is a claim about somewhere real, while the authored-fiction route makes no such claim. That is exactly the distinction assertProductionCatalogBoundary was built to protect, so the choice should be made rather than defaulted into. Raised by the coordinator session, and recorded as their reading rather than as an answer.

QUESTION 3 CHANGES THE SIZE OF THE JOB. political-belief-formation.ts is not a thin wrapper: it is a formation machine with factors, conviction, salience, flexibility and supersession, and its only caller is also the demo. Going through it makes the first caller a substantially bigger piece than one record; going around it means writing a belief the machine did not form, which may be the wrong precedent. Raised by the people-and-life lane.

METHOD NOTE, and the reason this record was corrected. A zero-caller result on the innermost writer is NOT the claim 'nothing can start this'. The divergence lane reported that nothing could open a scandal, having stopped at the two functions that write an allegation; the chain is in fact entered two levels further up on the weekly press sweep, and the true finding was narrower and better. Warned of that, this lane re-walked its own chain and found the same mistake in it: the first version of this record named four recorders whose only caller is the demo, and missed recordPrivateBelief entirely, and above it a whole exported NPC formation routine. The corrected finding is smaller and more actionable. Where this walk stopped: at applyNpcPoliticalBeliefFormation's importers, having confirmed the only non-test one is demo.ts and that no scheduled step registers it.

This is lamontae's headline stated as a repository fact, and it is smaller than his summary suggests. He described the apparatus as built at both ends and connected at neither, which is exactly right, and one of the three obstacles has already gone: the catalog can now carry the propositions a belief would point at.

Deliberately NOT asked here: what a belief should then DO — whether it moves a vote, a campaign or a relationship. That is downstream of an enacted law's effects machinery and belongs to the 'What passing a law actually does' lane. This record asks only what creates the record, not what reads it.
One of seven records from this sweep, and the one to answer first if only one is answered.
question: Three questions, in the order they block each other. (1) Does a policy proposition belong in the sourced us-state-and-local pack, or in a second pack declared as authored fiction? (2) What act in an ordinary life should record that a person now holds a view about one — and what supplies the occasion: a news story, a disaster in their state, a conversation, a vote, or holding office through an event? (3) Should the first version go THROUGH the existing belief-formation machine, or around it?

title: What makes a person in the game form a view, and when
usableAnswer: For (1), which pack, and if the sourced one, what a proposition's provenance would name. For (2), one occasion is enough: which act records a view, about which proposition, at what strength, and whether it is private belief, public statement or both. For (3), a yes or no plus a sentence of why, because it decides whether this is one caller or a much larger piece of work.
whyItMatters: lamontae's own summary of his ten-year playtest is that the world diverges richly and nobody in it is changed by what happens. This is that sentence as a wiring gap. Both ends are built and neither is connected: nothing in ordinary play records a belief, and the surface that would show one is finished and waiting. It is the difference between a simulation of events and a game about people, and he rates relationships, personality and private goals his first priority.

answer.summary:
(1) Put fictional policy propositions in the existing authored-fiction pack form, referring to existing sourced issue keys. A policy vocabulary source is not evidence that a fictional proposal was enacted. Do not import the synthetic demo as production content or disable the production boundary. Preserve the current useful issue IDs while the earlier 14-domain/13-domain crosswalk is received.

(2) First live occasion: a person legitimately encounters a concrete proposal through a conversation, a report, an office briefing or their experience of a supported operative policy. Record what they actually learned; connect relevant existing goals, values, appraisals, expertise and earlier views to the proposal. The evaluator receives these source-linked factors. Current source defaults to a moderate no-opinion consideration: an empty scheduled call does not supply personally meaningful reasons. A scheduler and one proposition row alone are insufficient for depth.

(3) Go THROUGH evaluatePoliticalBeliefFormation and applyNpcPoliticalBeliefFormation for NPCs. They already validate sources and persist a decision trace. The outcome can be no-opinion, defer, conflicted, tentative or settled support/opposition. Initial weak/secondhand evidence should normally be capable of tentative or unresolved results, not require a position. Conviction is not salience and neither is inflexibility.

Use a stable actor + proposition/selected proposal revision + new-evidence identity. Duplicate headlines and opening the Journal are not new evidence. Reconsider when new relevant facts, commitments or experience arrive; do not repeatedly reroll an unchanged issue until support appears. Private belief stays private; public declaration, promise and vote each have their own existing act. Never apply the NPC writer to the controlled player; give the player an explicit view/statement choice. Broad proposition-family preference is not unconditional agreement to every amount, target or exemption in a specific bill. Version/bind the actual proposal context before a consumer uses it to infer a bill-level position.

Acceptance ChatGPT requests (not executed): In an ordinary generated world, two differently situated NPCs encounter the same valid proposal and receive inspectable different factors; either may remain uncertain. An unexposed control knows nothing new. Re-reading the same article adds no second persuasion event. A change of material bill terms causes explicit reassessment, not reuse of an unrelated broad view.
